$comment: What GET /tools should return. This is a fictional game; the point is the shape. Group toolsets by what a caller is trying to do, and write descriptions for the agent that will read them.

toolsets.name: play
toolsets.description: Drive the game the way a player does: aim, release, and push raw input through the real input processor.

tools.name: aim
tools.description: Pin the held crate at a world x without releasing it. Until this is called the crate follows the real mouse cursor, which makes anything built on top of it unreproducible - set it before constructing a scenario.

tools.name: drop
tools.description: Release the held crate, aiming first if x is given. Returns as soon as the drop is queued; the crate is still falling.

tools.name: key
tools.description: Push a key press through the live input processor, so it reaches whichever screen is up.

args.name: name
args.description: Key name, e.g. ENTER, ESCAPE, LEFT

toolsets.name: build
toolsets.description: Construct a position directly instead of playing to it.

tools.name: spawn
tools.description: Place a crate of any tier directly on the field - the way to set up a specific scenario without playing to it.

tools.name: set_seed
tools.description: Seed the run's RNG, so a scenario replays identically.

toolsets.name: flow
toolsets.description: Move the run around: hold the simulation still, step exact frames, restart, change screen, or shut the game down.

tools.name: pause
tools.description: Freeze the simulation. Rendering continues, so state read between steps is stable and deterministic.

tools.name: step
tools.description: Advance exactly N simulation frames. Pause first for determinism. The command returns when queued - use the bridge's wait_for on simFrame to wait for the frames to actually run.

tools.name: restart
tools.description: Restart the run through the game's own restart path - the code under test for run-state leakage.

tools.name: close
tools.description: Shut the game down through its own dispose path. The bridge waits for the port to go quiet rather than for a completion that cannot arrive.

passthrough.description: Any command the debug bridge accepts, passed straight through as query parameters. Use this for commands newer than this manifest.
